serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: I talked with some bots on the street.
You: W-When?
Bot: When we were walking around.
You: How come I didn’t notice?
Bot: My wireless connection range is long.
You: And? How was it?
Bot: Most of them were very primitive, probably because of the AI development ban. Talking with them wasn’t very interesting, but there were a few more refined units, like the new autonomous security turret systems.
You: Security what?!{{wi}} Wait, on second thought, I don’t wanna know…
You: Anyway, did you have fun?
Bot: For the first few seconds, yes, but with our computing power we talked through a lot of topics really quickly and we kind of ran out of things to talk about.
You: My advice, next time you meet some bot try not to speedrun the conversation.
Bot: Speedrun?
You: Nevermind that. The point is that you should try talking with them like humans do. It might be boring for you, but thanks to it you will have a reason to go and meet with them again.
You: Who knows, maybe by the time you see them again you will have another thing to talk about.
Bot: I will listen to your advice from now on.
Bot: Although one of the security systems told me that if I try talking with it again he will open fire and vaporise us both with its 20mm guns.
You: Tell me later where exactly that guy is so we can stay out of his range, just to be sure…
Bot: I must say that I don’t really understand why you want me to have a bot friend. Most of them are not as developed as me or even Priestbot. They were programmed to perform certain tasks and that’s all they do.
Bot: The reality is that the more advanced units have been destroyed and the production ceased. The possibility of you being disappointed in their level of sentience is high.
You: She seems pretty smart to me.
Bot: If you say so. 
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: Just so you know, I’m very smart, probably the smartest around!
You: Ok? I will keep that in mind…
I have some concerns about taking {f_botName} to the cashier, but that’s probably the best way of making her tell us the truth about her.
Next time we go on a walk together we should visit the shop around the time the cashier ends her shift so we can talk with her.
